products.name: Dataiku
products.note: Collaborative data science platform; MLOps; governance workflows; EU-hosted options; GDPR relevant

profile_text.body:
Dataiku is a software company whose platform is designed to help enterprises build, deploy, and govern AI and machine learning at scale. The company describes itself as "the Platform for AI Success," positioning its product around the integration of people, orchestration, and governance to convert AI investments into measurable business outcomes. Its platform covers collaborative data science, MLOps, and governance workflows, and is available with EU-hosted options relevant to GDPR compliance.

Dataiku's platform is used by organizations including Novartis, Johnson & Johnson's Vision team, and Michelin, which the company says uses Dataiku across more than 50 global manufacturing sites spanning R&D, manufacturing, and services. The product includes a feature called LLM Mesh, cited in connection with Novartis's healthcare market research work, and supports generative AI use cases alongside traditional analytics pipelines. For the fifth consecutive year, Dataiku has been named a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI Platforms for Data Science and ML, recognized for both "Completeness of Vision" and "Ability to Execute." A Dataiku and Harris Poll survey of 900 CEOs across eight global markets found that 80% of CEOs say their role is at risk if their company fails to deliver measurable AI gains by the end of 2026.

The site's held facts record no litigation or regulatory cases against Dataiku, and no MCP server registry presence or SEC filings are noted.
